title: A flat local homomorphism of local rings is surjective on spectra
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ and $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be local rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$). Then $\varphi$ is faithfully flat; in particular the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is surjective.
